history.title: Version 1.3.0 — Custom Model & Accessory Importer, Multi-Channel PBR, Themes, Base Alpha/Eraser & Local Anim Gizmos
highlights: ## 🎭 Custom 3D Model Replacement & Accessory / Outfit Importer

**Full Custom Character Replacement:** Import `.glb`, `.gltf`, and `.fbx` models in the **Interactive 3D Fitting Room** with a translucent ghost hero reference mannequin, transform gizmos, axis locking, and multi-material inspection.
**Landmark Auto-Rigging & 3D Weight Paint Editor:**
- Automatically rig custom characters using Source 2 KNN donor skin-weight transfer with anatomical capsule fallback, or place manual anatomical Landmarks for exact bone alignment.
- Refine skin weights live in 3D with interactive Paint & Smooth weight brushes, X-Ray wireframe inspection, and T-Pose inverse baking.
- Keep unreplaced vanilla weapons/props intact cleanly inside exported `.vmdl_c` mods, with full `.dpp` session persistence.
**Accessory & Outfit Part Importer:**

- Add standalone hats, glasses, capes, backpacks, or custom props rigidly to quick-pick skeleton sockets (`Head`, `Chest / Back`, `Right Hand`, `Left Hand`, `Pelvis`, or full skeleton picker), or replace individual vanilla hero submeshes without rebuilding the whole hero.
- Fine-tune fit with independent X/Y/Z axis scaling, `Snap Grip` / `Straighten`, and clean slot management inside **Mod Changes**.
**Hero Mesh Deformer & 3D Sculpt Brush:** Sculpt, push, pull, flatten, or smooth original hero meshes (such as hair or tall collars) in 3D so custom hats and accessories fit without clipping.
**Deadlock Material Conversion:** Automatically converts imported model & accessory textures to sanitized Source 2 Deadlock PBR/toon shaders with AO, Normal, and Roughness map detection.
## 🎨 Multi-Channel Material Painting, Base Texture Eraser & Alpha Control

**Multi-Channel PBR Texture Support:** Inspect, paint, import, and export across **Color (Albedo)**, **Normal**, **Roughness**, **Ambient Occlusion (AO)**, **Shadow Map**, and **Self-Illum / Emissive** channels—with smart 2D canvas toolbar filtering that hides maps absent on the active material.

**Base Texture Unlock & Eraser-to-Transparency:** Unlock the **BASE TEXTURE** layer to paint over, apply Filters / Color Adjustments / Gradient Maps directly onto it, or erase base pixels straight to alpha transparency.
**Clip Paint Layers to Base Alpha & Alpha Preview:**
- Keep **Clip Paint Layers to Base Alpha** enabled to prevent brush strokes and fills from bleeding into Source 2 transparent cutouts and packed masks.
- Inspect live alpha masks in the 2D UV Canvas using the **Alpha Preview** toggle and transparency checkerboard backdrop, plus alpha-scissored outlines in the 3D viewport.
**Tiled/Negative UV Wrapping & Stability Fixes:**
- Fixed out-of-bounds UV islands on heroes and props via proper `fract(UV)` wrapping in both the 2D UV canvas and 3D GPU brush projection.
- Fixed purple missing-texture overlays on material switching/LRU eviction and eliminated disposed VPK stream errors during workspace texture restoration.
## 🎬 Animation Studio: Local Gizmos, Mod Editing & Source 2 Constraints

**Local / Global 3D Gizmo Coordinate Space:** Toggle between **Local bone axes** and **Global world axes** from the Animation Studio toolbar, `Key Actions` menu, `Bones` tab, or hotkey **`L`** for natural joint posing.

**Addon Animation Mod Editing & Re-Export:** Load existing `.vnmclip_c` animation mods from your addon picker under the new `"Modified"` category, tweak curves or poses in the Animation Studio, and re-export cleanly with fixed Source 2 IK chain & constraint handling.

**Source 2 Constraints, Jiggle Bones & Secondary `.vnmskel` Retargeting:** Full `Source2BoneConstraintDriver` evaluation across all 11 ModelDoc constraints and `FeModel` jiggle springs, plus accurate additive decoding on secondary `.vnmskel` skeletons.
## 🎨 UI Theme System, Markdown Changelogs & Engine Upgrade
**Custom UI Theme System:** Switch between built-in studio themes, customize accent and surface colors, and export/import shareable JSON theme presets.

**VRF 21.1, .NET 11.0 & Non-Standard `.vpk` Mods:** Upgraded core parsing to `ValveResourceFormat 21.1` on `.NET 11.0` with SoA `ParticleSystemSimulation`, lock-free deferred VPK reads, non-standard community `.vpk` addon discovery, and safe in-place `.vpk` overwriting.

**UI Polish & Rich Markdown Changelogs:** Cleaner Fitting Room top toolbars, persistent submesh visibility across tab switches (fixing parts like Viscous inflated mesh reappearing), and full Markdown rendering across the in-app Update Modal, Web Showcase, and Release Hub.

history.title: Version 1.2.0 — New Filters & Adjustments for Painting & Animation Editor, Importer and Exporter (Beta)
highlights: ## 🎬 Animation Player & Animation Studio Deck Overhaul (Beta)
Expanded Animation Library & Categories: Ingests significantly more in-game animations across expanded tokenized categories.
New Animation Studio Deck Editor.
Dope Sheet View: Timeline ruler, master summary row, diamond keyframe glyphs, marquee multi-select, box snapping, and batch retiming.
Graph Editor View: Interactive Bezier F-Curves for bone translation ($X, Y, Z$) and continuous Euler rotation (Roll, Pitch, Yaw) with Auto, Aligned, Vector, and Free tangent modes.
F-Curve Modifiers: Procedural non-destructive curve modifiers including Noise, Cycles, Stepped, and Envelope / Limits.
Auto-Keying & 3D Gizmo Integration: Manipulating bones via viewport gizmos automatically inserts keyframes at the active playhead frame (🔴 Auto-Key).
Quick Tools & Key Actions: Pose copy/paste, pose mirroring, clip duration scaling, and instant GLB scene export.

External Animation Importer & Retargeting System: import external humanoid animations (.glb, .gltf, .fbx) directly to replace character animations. Tested with Mixamo and Mesh2Motion character animations.
Native VPK Animation Export (.vnmclip_c)
🎨 Texture Painting: New Filters, Adjustments & Clone Tool
Advanced Color Adjustments: Gradient Map, Levels, Threshold & Posterize and Exposure & Color Balance
Image Filter Suite: Blur, SHarpen, Pixelate, Stylize and Noise
New Clone Stamp Tool: Sample source texels across 2D UV canvas and 3D mesh surfaces to clone, touch up, and blend character skin, clothing patterns, and textures.
Normal Map & VTEX Alpha Preservation Fix: Resolved a critical issue where compiling textures stripped or corrupted the .vtex_c alpha channel.
Material Archetype & Texture Format Detection: Added auto-detection for g_tAltColor_Reveal and g_tAltColor shader parameters.

history.title: Version 1.1.0-beta — Painter Overhaul, Particle VFX Studio & Workspace (.dpp)
highlights: VPK Library updated to latest release 20.1, allowing correct hero loading.
Per-material native resolution painting architecture with material-grouped submesh hierarchy.
New 3D & 2D Shape Tools (Square, Circle, Line), Selection Mask Suite (Rectangular, Lasso, Polygonal), and interactive 3D/2D Transform Gizmos for Decals, Text, and Shapes.
Deterministic 3D CPU Particle VFX Simulator & Editor: paint particle textures and customize emitter Size, Alpha, Constant Color, Random Color Min/Max, and Color Fade with direct .vpcf_c VPK export.
Multi-asset Mod Workspace Session and unified .dpp project files preserving layers, blend modes, Extra Models, and VFX across multiple heroes.
Full Extra Models support for editing hero summons, weapons, and ability props.
Redesigned UI with illustrated sidebar buttons, visual card gallery modals (Heroes, Mods, Extra Models, Particle thumbnails).
Website release.

history.title: Version 1.0.0 — Initial Public Release
highlights: Native Valve pak01_dir.vpk archive reader and Source 2 binary parser (.vmdl_c, .vmat_c, .vtex_c, .vanim_c).
Real-time 3D CameraBrush texture painting and 2D UV canvas dock with non-destructive multi-layer stack.
Skeletal FK/IK posing suite with Gizmo3DSharp and procedural cloth simulation (Position-Based Dynamics).
Bespoke shaders for Infernus, Lady Geist, Viscous, Vindicta, Lash, Wraith and more heroes.
One-click direct mod export pipeline compiling custom skins into pak##_dir.vpk files directly in Citadel addons.
